Mi siguiente paso es ajustar numéricamente unos modelos simples (constante, lineal, cuadrático) para escoger uno parsimonioso y luego someter la entrega.
```python
import numpy as np, pandas as pd

# assemble all lot-level data
frames = []
for T, df in exp_runs.items():
    frames.append(pd.DataFrame({"T": df["T"].astype(float), "y": df["y"].astype(float), "src": f"exp_{T}"}))
for T, df in confirm_runs.items():
    frames.append(pd.DataFrame({"T": df["T"].astype(float), "y": df["y"].astype(float), "src": f"confirm_{T}"}))
frames.append(pd.DataFrame({"T": np.ones(len(monitoreo)), "y": monitoreo["y"].astype(float), "src": "monitoreo"}))
frames.append(pd.DataFrame({"T": np.ones(len(hist)), "y": hist["y"].astype(float), "src": "archivo"}))
all_df = pd.concat(frames, ignore_index=True)

print("all data shape:", all_df.shape)
print(all_df.groupby("src")["y"].agg(["count","mean","std"]))

# fit simple mean models
x = all_df["T"].to_numpy()
y = all_df["y"].to_numpy()

X0 = np.column_stack([np.ones(len(x))])
b0 = np.linalg.lstsq(X0, y, rcond=None)[0]
rss0 = ((y - X0 @ b0)**2).sum()

X1 = np.column_stack([np.ones(len(x)), x - 1.0])
b1 = np.linalg.lstsq(X1, y, rcond=None)[0]
rss1 = ((y - X1 @ b1)**2).sum()

X2 = np.column_stack([np.ones(len(x)), x - 1.0, (x - 1.0)**2])
b2 = np.linalg.lstsq(X2, y, rcond=None)[0]
rss2 = ((y - X2 @ b2)**2).sum()

print("\nmodel fits:")
print("constant beta:", b0, "rss:", rss0, "sigma:", np.sqrt(rss0/len(y)))
print("linear beta:", b1, "rss:", rss1, "sigma:", np.sqrt(rss1/len(y)))
print("quadratic beta:", b2, "rss:", rss2, "sigma:", np.sqrt(rss2/len(y)))

# estimate process sigma from experiment-only data, discounting measurement noise roughly
exp_only = pd.concat(
    [pd.DataFrame({"T": df["T"].astype(float), "y": df["y"].astype(float)}) for df in exp_runs.values()] +
    [pd.DataFrame({"T": df["T"].astype(float), "y": df["y"].astype(float)}) for df in confirm_runs.values()],
    ignore_index=True
)
resid = exp_only["y"] - (b1[0] + b1[1]*(exp_only["T"] - 1.0))
meas_sd = lot_summ["std"].mean()
total_sd = resid.std(ddof=1)
proc_sd = max(0.1, np.sqrt(max(0, total_sd**2 - meas_sd**2)))

print("\nnoise estimates:")
print("measurement sd approx:", meas_sd)
print("total residual sd exp-only:", total_sd)
print("implied process sd approx:", proc_sd)

frames.append(pd.DataFrame({"T": np.ones(len(hist)), "y": hist["y"].astype(float), "src": "archivo"}))
all_df = pd.concat(frames, ignore_index=True)

print(all_df.groupby("src")["y"].agg(["count","mean","std"]))

# fit simple mean models
x = all_df["T"].to_numpy()
y = all_df["y"].to_numpy()

X0 = np.column_stack([np.ones(len(x))])
b0 = np.linalg.lstsq(X0, y, rcond=None)[0]
rss0 = ((y - X0 @ b0)**2).sum()

X1 = np.column_stack([np.ones(len(x)), x - 1.0])
b1 = np.linalg.lstsq(X1, y, rcond=None)[0]
rss1 = ((y - X1 @ b1)**2).sum()

X2 = np.column_stack([np.ones(len(x)), x - 1.0, (x - 1.0)**2])
b2 = np.linalg.lstsq(X2, y, rcond=None)[0]
rss2 = ((y - X2 @ b2)**2).sum()

print("\nmodel fits:")
print("constant beta:", b0, "rss:", rss0, "sigma:", np.sqrt(rss0/len(y)))
print("linear beta:", b1, "rss:", rss1, "sigma:", np.sqrt(rss1/len(y)))
print("quadratic beta:", b2, "rss:", rss2, "sigma:", np.sqrt(rss2/len(y)))

# estimate process sigma from experiment-only data, discounting measurement noise roughly
exp_only = pd.concat(
    [pd.DataFrame({"T": df["T"].astype(float), "y": df["y"].astype(float)}) for df in exp_runs.values()] +
    [pd.DataFrame({"T": df["T"].astype(float), "y": df["y"].astype(float)}) for df in confirm_runs.values()],
    ignore_index=True
)
resid = exp_only["y"] - (b1[0] + b1[1]*(exp_only["T"] - 1.0))
meas_sd = lot_summ["std"].mean()
total_sd = resid.std(ddof=1)
proc_sd = max(0.1, np.sqrt(max(0, total_sd**2 - meas_sd**2)))

print("\nnoise estimates:")
print("measurement sd approx:", meas_sd)
print("total residual sd exp-only:", total_sd)
print("implied process sd approx:", proc_sd)
